name: generic
description: Any Flow clip, any project. Checks what every Flow clip should get right; format rules only when the project sets them.
visual_checklist: Each clip shows the scene its prompt asked for (compare with expected_visuals when a script was given)
No text, letters, subtitles, captions, watermarks or stray logos anywhere in the frame
Faces look natural and stay the same through the clip — no melting, warping or changing features
Hands are natural: five fingers each, plausible grip, nothing fused or bending wrongly
Objects keep their shape, colour and size — nothing morphs, appears or vanishes
The same character looks the same across clips (face, hair, clothes)
No two clips are the same shot (redundant clip) and the clips are in the intended order
Lip check: only the person who is actually speaking moves their lips, in sync; nobody on screen 'dubs' a voice-over
